means: The board reset is NOT the mask. With a reset that demonstrably resets, 6 of 8 against 5 of 8 - no difference. So the reading this bench proposed for the bisect landing is refuted, and 24488b4 stands as the boundary with no explanation for why.
not_claimed: Any mechanism. Two readings of this landing have now been proposed and both failed.
platform_finding: On linux-x1 a plain open of the programming port at 115200 does NOT reset the board. An explicit DTR toggle does: dev_us 16433.8 s -> 5.7 s. CLAUDE.md states that opening the control port resets the board over NRSTB as a general fact; on this bench it depends on how the port is opened.

valid_run.design: explicit DTR toggle, verified to reset, interleaved arm by arm

void_attempt.why_void: the board was never reset. dev_us read 16410.9 s before and 16415.9 s after - it INCREASED by exactly the sleep. Both arms were the same condition, which is why they read the same, and the arm would have been reported as a refutation.

what_is_left: 24488b4 touches host/ports.py and host/measure.py, neither in the daemon's read path, yet it is reproducibly the boundary. Its own message also describes a change around helpers.assert_fresh and first_seq, which is the same field the failure signature turns on. Not yet read in diff.
